messages.content: I had this but in a different story, when got lucky my model scored over 1000 points and i landed into top 5 :) but then left it for a while and it went to normal 900ish range. So the way I test, I run 2 submissions over 4 hours it give me rough score, but then i would wait over a day and then its more stable. I am not pokemon player but too many random factors comes in play. Ive seen many times where model just cant do better as cards are bad. So i would say give it a day and then you can see where it goes.
